title: PULSE-PID-TIMING: joint timing-energy-PID waveform ablation bakeoff

raw_root_reproduction.definition: baseline-subtracted B2/B4/B6/B8 even-channel pulse with max(HRDv - median(samples 0..3)) > 1000 ADC

endpoint_specific_heldout_runs.pedestal: held-out quiet/analysis run blocks from S16 pedestal validation

bootstrap.unit: held-out run block or endpoint-defined held-out run fold

methods_required.ridge: included where endpoint supports tabular ML
methods_required.gradient_boosted_trees: included for timing, charge, energy, two-pulse, truth-pileup, pedestal, saturation, PID
methods_required.mlp: included for timing, charge, energy, two-pulse, truth-pileup, saturation, PID
methods_required.cnn_1d: included for timing, energy, two-pulse, truth-pileup, saturation, PID

winner_rationale: Gradient-boosted trees are the most robust cross-endpoint winner: best timing sigma68, best two-pulse time RMS, best truth-pileup average precision, best PID balanced accuracy, and best pedestal MAE under the HGBR calibrated variant. The physics traditional GEANT4-Birks baseline remains the single-endpoint winner for energy resolution, random forests/extra trees win duplicate amplitude/charge closure, and the 1D CNN wins the saturation action-gate utility endpoint. Overall winner is therefore by cross-endpoint dominance count rather than by a single heterogeneous scalar.
caveat: This ticket artifact is an academic synthesis and endpoint-normalized bakeoff assembled from already materialized run-held-out raw-ROOT-derived studies in the repository. It does not rerun every neural model end-to-end in this turn; the raw ROOT reproduction gate and all reported endpoint metrics are traced to the listed artifacts.
